description: Backtest an owned Felix-generated strategy by strategy_id on real historical data. Returns the chart-ready summary and replay attestation by default. Use start_backtest for large histories. User-supplied code is refused.

bars.description: Historical bars; interval-specific limits apply and are validated locally.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry-safety key. Reuse the exact key after an interrupted synchronous request.

strategy_id.description: Owned strategy UUID returned by generate_strategy.

years.description: Historical years. Overrides bars; use interval=1d for up to 40 years.

name: backtest
